test_cases.title: Should be able to archive an eligible Billing To master while its invoices keep listing, filtering and exporting with their Invoice Type (archive unchanged, T-009 archive half)
preconditions: Billing To master BTM-INV001-A exists with invoice_print_type = direct_debit
Confirmed billing + invoice R151-INV001-001 linked to BTM-INV001-A exists
steps: Archive BTM-INV001-A (active = False) following the existing archive rules
POST /api/dataset/sales.billing.invoice/search_read with domain [["sales_billing_invoice_no","=","R151-INV001-001"]]
